description: This file implements a WebSocket server class (WSServer) with methods to start listening on a port, handle upgrades, manage connections, and close the server. It includes configuration for per-message deflate compression and delegates for handling requests, headers, upgrades, and connections.

classes.name: WSServer
classes.description: A class managing WebSocket server lifecycle, including listening, upgrade handling, connection management, and shutdown.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes WSServer with a delegate for handling server events.

methods.name: listen
methods.description: Starts the HTTP and WebSocket server, sets up upgrade handling, and returns the WebSocket endpoint URL.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the WebSocket and HTTP servers, closing all active connections.
